title: Real World English
summary: 旅行、社交、听说读写综合实战与阶段验收。
objectives: Combine travel and social communication skills
Use time, prices and evidence to choose a plan
Complete an integrated listening, reading, speaking and writing task

lessons.title: Arrive and Adapt
lessons.subtitle: 处理列车取消并确认新行程

listening.title: Arrive and Adapt
listening.transcript: The ten o’clock train is cancelled. Your ticket is valid on the 10:40 train. If you prefer, there’s a replacement bus at 10:20 from the main entrance. The bus takes ninety minutes.

questions.q: When does the replacement bus leave?

passages.title: A phone reminder
passages.transcript: Hi, I’m calling from the tourist office to confirm your booking. We’re holding the visitor briefing on Monday. It starts at 13 fifteen. You can call back if you’d like to change your booking.

questions.q: On which day does the event take place?
What time does the event begin?

passages.title: At the front desk
passages.transcript: Welcome to the tourist office! Are you here for the visitor briefing? Please meet us in the River Room. The session lasts 25 minutes. It begins at 13 fifteen. I can show you where to go.

passages.title: A ticket enquiry
passages.transcript: Thanks for asking about the visitor briefing. It lasts 25 minutes. A ticket costs 4 pounds. We have space for 18 people. We’ll give you a map when you arrive.

passages.title: A message from the organiser
passages.transcript: A quick note for everyone joining the visitor briefing at the tourist office. There are 18 places. Use the north entrance. Please bring a pencil. If you need help, ask for Eli. See you there!

questions.q: What are visitors asked to bring?

speaking.prompt: 选择列车或巴士，向旅伴说明时间和抵达酒店后的安排。
speaking.sample: Let’s take the 10:40 train. We’ll reach the hotel at about 11:45 and wait in the lobby.

listening.title: Final Challenge: A Weekend Abroad
listening.transcript: Your train now arrives at eleven twenty. The hotel can hold your bag from noon, but the room won’t be ready until three. Lin can meet at two if you’re free, or at four after you check in.

questions.q: When will the room be ready?

passages.title: A phone reminder
passages.transcript: Hi, I’m calling from the tourist office to confirm your booking. We’re holding the visitor briefing on Sunday. It starts at 11 fifteen. You can call back if you’d like to change your booking.

questions.q: On which day does the event take place?
What time does the event begin?

passages.title: At the front desk
passages.transcript: Welcome to the tourist office! Are you here for the visitor briefing? Please meet us in the Garden Room. The session lasts 45 minutes. It begins at 11 fifteen. I can show you where to go.

passages.title: A ticket enquiry
passages.transcript: Thanks for asking about the visitor briefing. It lasts 45 minutes. A ticket costs 5 pounds. We have space for 14 people. We’ll give you a map when you arrive.

passages.title: A message from the organiser
passages.transcript: A quick note for everyone joining the visitor briefing at the tourist office. There are 14 places. Use the south entrance. Please bring a pencil. If you need help, ask for Sofia. See you there!

questions.q: What are visitors asked to bring?

speaking.prompt: 做两分钟任务：先给酒店打电话确认寄存，再与 Lin 敲定活动，解释取舍并给出天气备选。
speaking.sample: Could you keep my bag from noon? Lin, let’s meet at four. If we book by noon, the museum is within budget. If it stays dry, the free walk is another option.
